The '''Tellivar system''' was a part of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Tellivar Lady]]''.<ref name="Nightlily">{{StoryCite|story=Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tellivar [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-9.<ref name="TEA" />
